title: Chuck and Chuckles become a separate act
summary: After four and a half years Nazarro and Bubbles let them go as their own comedy act.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: With Buck and Bubbles at that time.
This was at the height of your performance with Buck and Bubbles, when you were about 18?
Yeah. Yeah. I had become 18, you know.
How many years had you been performing with Buck and Bubbles by the time you were 18?
Well, I had been involved with them for about five years approximately. You could say four and a half.
So your act was beginning to refine itself a bit.
Yes. They were getting ready to let us out, off the hook, as I would call it. We would, you know, get a chance to be separate acts.
Now, what was the difference, performing with them and then as a separate act? How did you change your act?

Well, we changed our act by becoming a new comedian, a new comedy act, see. At first there was two comedy acts in one comedy act, so we had to make that was a bit of the Nat Nazzara and one comedy act. So that's (Unintelligible) John Bubbles, you see. They thought that would be nice.
